title: pairlint config
description: Which design tokens pairlint checks against which, in which modes.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion.

level.description: The WCAG level whose contrast ratios pairs must meet.

format.description: Format of JSON token files. Files ending in .css are always read as CSS.

tokens.description: Token files for a single mode. Next to "modes", files every mode loads first.

modes.description: Token files per mode, like { "light": [...], "dark": [...] }. An object instead of a list is a group, and groups combine: { "brand": {...}, "theme": {...} }.

base.description: The color translucent backgrounds sit on. One color or {alias}, or an object keyed by mode name or group value.

baseline.description: Baseline file of accepted failures, relative to this config.

pairs.description: Which tokens are checked against which. Every foreground is checked against every background.

source.description: A token file relative to this config. Add #set for a Tokens Studio set, or #selector or #@media query for CSS.

patterns.description: A token id or pattern, or a list of them. * matches within one segment and ** matches any number of segments.

use.description: body: 4.5:1 (AAA 7:1). large: 3:1 (AAA 4.5:1). ui: 3:1, for borders, icons and controls. exempt: not checked.

min.description: A custom minimum ratio that replaces the WCAG threshold.

reason.description: Why this pair is set up this way. Required when use is exempt.

modes.description: Check this pair only in these modes. Full mode names or group values like "dark".
